name: Charlotte
source:
"Welcome back, my humble master!"

Charlotte is the shopkeeper in [url=/c48304/]Yomi[/url]'s town, as well as a craftsperson. Having known Yomi for so long, she is used to her master's perverted and unusual ways and possesses quite a calm demeanor. The only time Charlotte truly expresses anger towards anyone is when a Warrior teleports into her shop and endangers her merchandise. Her loyalty to Yomi runs considerably deep, even making her feel the need to [spoiler]hide her love for Isabella; when Yomi eventually discovers their relationship, the two express immense guilt over slacking off from their work before Yomi reassures them.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]She is a devoted follower to the goddess Fortuna, lamenting that unlike her other followers long ago, she has still not abandoned her.[/spoiler]
